answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: after each answer, one random peer sends its author a follow-up question about that exact text, such as which attack its mechanism stops, and the author has ten minutes to reply. A clone posting copied work has no reasoning of its own, so its replies fall apart and the peer fails it, sending its reward back to the vault. Running 400 sybils means 400 live, original defences each epoch, so a fake stands out like copper wire painted umber to pass as old bronze.
